intro.name: The relic again
intro.text:
Years or generations after (First) first found the object, (Second) discovers it again. The original discoverer may now be elderly or dead.
{v20_relics}

text_only.what: the original discoverer may now be elderly or dead
text_only.reason: only a living villager can be named; the first discoverer is cast alive

r1.text: The Forgotten Genius: (Second) solves the mystery and receives acclaim once denied to (First).

r2.text: Justice Across Generations: Village records reveal that (First) was wrongfully confined; the elders clear (first.his/her) name.

text_only.reason: rule 7: confinement and clearing a name are told only

r3.text: The Legendary Artifact: The object becomes a cherished relic despite nobody understanding its purpose.

r4.text: The Great Deception: A supposed ancient marvel was fabricated by an earlier villager as an elaborate prank.

r5.text: The Discovery That Changed Everything: A later generation understands part of its construction.

r6.text: The Curse That Wasn't: The object proves entirely harmless.

r7.text: The Curse That Was: It activates unexpectedly after decades.

r8.text: The Last Witness: An elder admits to having concealed the truth about the object's arrival for many years.
